name: newsletter-card
title: Newsletter card
description: A compact subscribe card for sidebars and article ends: a line of promise, one field, one button and a note on frequency.
docs: Pass title, description, onSubmit (resolve to confirm, reject to show the error), promise, cta, privacyHref and compact. The card is built to be 20rem wide in a sidebar and lays out in two columns when it is wide, because it follows its own width rather than the screen's. The address is checked in words before anything is sent. A failure keeps what was typed and turns the button into a retry; success replaces the form with a message that says what happens next, takes focus and is announced, and offers to start again. Compact leaves out the icon and the description for a footer column. value, defaultValue and onValueChange control the field; defaultStatus starts the card in success or error for a page that already knows the result. Pass labels to translate every fixed word and error.
